name: DESTINIA Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: DESTINIA is an acclaimed 2D action-RPG originally released by Gamevil and Morisoft for mobile devices. This port runs the compiled C shared library (libdestinia_jni.so) from the Android version natively on the PlayStation Vita's ARM Cortex-A9 processor using a dynamic loader (soloader) and Android environment emulation (FalsoJNI).
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
